title: Are You Buying The T-Mobile Dip
author: Upper-Worker8516
selftext:
TMUS is down around 28% since February.

If you look on a chart we seem to be at a potential support level around 160. To be honest, an AI stock platform flagged it as a potential opportunity, so I started digging into it and wanted to see what people here think.

I'm thinking about picking up 50 shares and then adding if I get some confirmation that it's actually turning.

The other option I'm looking at is selling the $160 put. It was paying around $440 when I checked.

Fundamentally what scares me is that T Mobile shot up from May 2024 and  peaked in February 2026. As of today, its given up all those gains. So for a Telco- its volatile like a tech stock.

What do you guys think ?

Wait a little longer or jump in now ?

comments.author: liuhaolin911
comments.body: Potential opportunity means you should try if it pays out, stop asking those stupid questions, set yourself up just do it

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: the put and the 50 shares aren't the same bet. one $160 put gets you assigned 100 shares, double what you said you wanted, and it happens right when price has broken the level you're calling support. if 50 is the size you're comfortable with, the put is too big for you here.

replies.author: Upper-Worker8516
replies.body: I'm thinking more on downside. Need to awnser question what if I'm wrong ?

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body:
write the wrong answer down before you buy: the price where you admit it, or the date. with 50 shares that's a loss you can live with. with the put it's 100 shares you didn't ask for, at the moment support just broke.

that rule, exit included, is what Quantradin runs with fake money. mine, I built it. quantradin.com
